name: Amphibia
description: The adventures of 13-year-old, self-centered Anne Boonchuy who is magically transported to the fictitious world of Amphibia, a rural marshland full of frog-people. With the help of an excitable young frog named Sprig, Anne will become a hero and discover the first true friendship of her life.

videos.title: Anne or Beast?
videos.overview: Sprig tries to capture a mysterious beast to prove that he’s responsible.

videos.title: Best Fronds
videos.overview: Sprig takes Anne swimming in a nearby lake to help her feel less homesick.

videos.title: Cane Crazy
videos.overview: When Anne breaks Hop Pop's favorite cane, she and her friends set out to replace it.

videos.title: Flood, Sweat & Tears
videos.overview: When Anne's bedroom floods, she and Sprig must bunk together.

videos.title: Hop Luck
videos.overview: To win a village cooking contest, Anne leads the family on a quest to make pizza.

videos.title: Stakeout
videos.overview: Sprig wants Anne and Hop Pop to get along, so he tricks them into going on a stakeout.

videos.title: The Domino Effect
videos.overview: Anne wants to keep a caterpillar as a pet, but she'll have to keep it a secret from Hop Pop.

videos.title: Taking Charge
videos.overview: After one of the Plantars mysteriously runs out the charge on Anne's phone, the family embarks on a mission to try and recharge it.

videos.title: Anne Theft Auto
videos.overview: In an attempt to learn to drive the family snail wagon, Anne and Sprig take it for a joy ride.

videos.title: Breakout Star
videos.overview: Anne's pimple breakout makes her a celebrity in Wartwood.

videos.title: Sprig Vs. Hop Pop
videos.overview: Angry with how the Plantar farm is being run, Sprig decides to overthrow Hop Pop.

videos.title: Girl Time
videos.overview: Anne plans to give Polly some long-overdue girl time, whether Polly wants it or not.

videos.title: Dating Season
videos.overview: Anne and Hop Pop learn Sprig may like Ivy Sundew, so they attempt to set them up.

videos.title: Anne Vs. Wild
videos.overview: Anne pretends to like camping, which is fine until she goes dangerously overboard.

videos.title: Contagi-Anne
videos.overview: Anne fakes getting sick to get off work, but the rest of the family gets sick.

videos.title: Family Shrub
videos.overview: Sprig and Polly think their family history is boring until they uncover family secrets.

videos.title: Lily Pad Thai
videos.overview: Anne gets a job at Stumpy’s diner and transforms the humble frog eatery into a flashy Thai fusion restaurant.

videos.title: Plantar’s Last Stand
videos.overview: When rent on the Plantar’s food stand skyrockets, Anne has to show Hop Pop the key to being a great salesman.

videos.title: Toad Tax
videos.overview: Anne befriends toad soldiers to gain respect in Wartwood.

videos.title: Prison Break
videos.overview: Toad Tower finds itself under attack by a pair of horrifying herons.

videos.title: Grubhog Day
videos.overview: During Grubhog Day, Sprig has to decide whether to uphold his responsibilities or have fun at the carnival.

videos.title: Hop Pop and Lock
videos.overview: To impress Sylvia Sundew, Hop Pop asks Anne to teach him to dance.

videos.title: Civil Wart
videos.overview: When Anne exposes Wartwood to a teen romance film, the town splits on the movie's love triangle.

videos.title: Hop-Popular
videos.overview: After losing his stand, Hop Pop decides to run for mayor of Wartwood.

videos.title: Croak and Punishment
videos.overview: When Sprig’s rare and precious Blue Moon Shell is stolen, he and Anne investigate to find the thief.

videos.title: Trip to the Archives
videos.overview: To prepare for Anne’s quest, the Plantars visit the town archives and accidentally get trapped.

videos.title: Snow Day
videos.overview: When a winter cold snap freezes all the frogs in Wartwood, Anne must protect the townspeople.

videos.title: Cracking Mrs. Croaker
videos.overview: In an effort to make Mrs. Croaker like him, Sprig digs up a secret from her past.

videos.title: A Night at the Inn
videos.overview: The Plantars stay at a bed and breakfast for the night, but Polly discovers the caretakers aren’t what they seem.

videos.title: Wally and Anne
videos.overview: Everyone calls Anne crazy when she claims to have seen the mythical Moss Man.

videos.title: Family Fishing Trip
videos.overview: Sprig wants to spend time with Hop Pop on their family fishing trip, but Hop Pop’s friend Sylvia gets in the way.

videos.title: Bizarre Bazaar
videos.overview: Anne’s music box goes missing at the mysterious and exclusive Bizarre Bazaar.

videos.title: Cursed!
videos.overview: After Anne helps Sprig break up with Maddie, strange things start happening to them.

videos.title: Fiddle Me This
videos.overview: When a popular talent competition comes to Wartwood, Hop Pop goes overboard in training Sprig to win.

videos.title: The Big Bugball Game
videos.overview: Anne must learn the value of teamwork to win the town's annual Bugball game.

videos.title: Combat Camp
videos.overview: Anne, Sprig and Polly are forced to stay at a daycare center that turns out to be more than it seems.

videos.title: Children of the Spore
videos.overview: A scary mushroom adventure!

videos.title: Anne of The Year
videos.overview: Anne wins the prestigious "Frog of the Year" award and gets to plan her own party, but the frogs of Wartwood may not be ready for a human-style bash.

videos.title: Reunion
videos.overview: During a banquet hosted by the toads, Anne is reunited with a friend from home.

videos.title: Handy Anne
videos.overview: Worried that something bad could happen while they are in Newtopia, Anne decides to disaster-proof the farm.

videos.title: Fort in the Road
videos.overview: Sprig longs for exotic road trip adventures, but Hop Pop’s strict road rules threaten to spoil all of his fun plans.

videos.title: The Ballad of Hopediah Plantar
videos.overview: Hop Pop stands up to the wrong family.

videos.title: Anne Hunter
videos.overview: Anne must put her self-consciousness aside in order to learn the true way of the hunter.

videos.title: Truck Stop Polly
videos.overview: Feeling unappreciated by her family, Polly hatches a plan to make them pay attention to her.

videos.title: A Caravan Named Desire
videos.overview: Hop Pop signs the family up to join a traveling theater troupe, hoping to realize his dream of being an actor.

videos.title: Quarreler's Pass
videos.overview: Hop Pop drops Sprig and Polly off at a trail designed to help them get along.

videos.title: Toadcatcher
videos.overview: Sasha and Grime must reconcile their differences to escape Newtopia’s most skilled warrior, General Yunnan.

videos.title: Swamp and Sensibility
videos.overview: When Anne discovers an old friend who has been living a double life, she becomes fixated on helping him be his true self.

videos.title: Wax Museum
videos.overview: The family visits a mysterious roadside oddities museum where every treasure comes with a price.

videos.title: Marcy at the Gates
videos.overview: The family must defeat an entire ant army before they enter Newtopia.

videos.title: Scavenger Hunt
videos.overview: Anne, Sprig and Marcy receive a mysterious message from the king of Newtopia that sends them on a puzzle-solving mission.

videos.title: The Plantars Check In
videos.overview: Anne finally meets with King Andrias and tries to enlist his help in getting back home.

videos.title: Lost in Newtopia
videos.overview: Anne and Polly vow to experience the city like locals but end up on a wild ride through the streets of Newtopia.

videos.title: Sprig Gets Schooled
videos.overview: Sprig is offered a spot at Newtopia University.

videos.title: Little Frogtown
videos.overview: Hop Pop investigates the disappearance of an old friend and the shadowy crime syndicate he suspects are behind it.

videos.title: Hopping Mall
videos.overview: Hop Pop takes the kids to a Newtopian shopping mall to buy souvenirs, and Anne will do anything to get the perfect gift for her mom back home.

videos.title: The Sleepover to End All Sleepovers
videos.overview: Anne and Marcy issue a Scare Dare Challenge that brings Sprig and Polly into forbidden areas of the castle.

videos.title: A Day at the Aquarium
videos.overview: Anne and the Plantars look to spend what could be their last day together at the Newtopia Aquarium.

videos.title: The Shut-In!
videos.overview: Anne and the Plantars protect themselves from the dangers of the annual Blue Moon by locking themselves in the house and entertaining each other with the scariest stories they can think of.

videos.title: Night Drivers
videos.overview: Sprig and Polly stay up all night to drive the family home.

videos.title: Return to Wartwood
videos.overview: The Plantars make it to Wartwood, and realize they forgot something important.

videos.title: Ivy on the Run
videos.overview: Fed up with her mother's strict rules, Ivy concocts a plan to run away.

videos.title: After the Rain
videos.overview: Anne asks Hop Pop to retrieve the music box, bringing some long-buried secrets to light.

videos.title: The First Temple
videos.overview: Marcy, Anne, and the Plantars travel to an ancient temple that could hold the key to getting Anne and Marcy home, but only if they can survive the temple's deadly challenges!

videos.title: New Wartwood
videos.overview: Intent on winning over Wartwood, Marcy makes a plan to improve the town.

videos.title: Friend or Frobo?
videos.overview: Desperate for fun, Polly breaks out on her own and finds an unlikely new friend in the process.

videos.title: Toad to Redemption
videos.overview: Mayor Toadstool is offered his dream job but realizes he doesn't want to leave Wartwood.

videos.title: Maddie & Marcy
videos.overview: Maddie is working on an important spell but her three baby sisters keep getting in the way.

videos.title: The Second Temple
videos.overview: Anne and Marcy's quest to get home takes them to an icy mountain temple, but they'll need help to find it.

videos.title: Barrel's Warhammer
videos.overview: Sasha and Grime go on a quest to retrieve a legendary Warhammer.

videos.title: Bessie & MicroAngelo
videos.overview: Bessie has her work cut out for her when she's tasked with showing MicroAngelo the ropes.

videos.title: The Third Temple
videos.overview: Anne and Marcy need the help of an old friend to survive a volcanic temple that holds the final key to returning home.

videos.title: The Dinner
videos.overview: Anne and the Plantars invite some old adversaries over for dinner to try to bury the hatchet.

videos.title: Battle of the Bands
videos.overview: Anne and her friends team up to enter the Wartwood Battle of the Bands contest.

videos.title: True Colors
videos.overview: The gang travels to Newtopia to say their goodbyes and finally send all three girls home. However, someone has other plans.

videos.title: The New Normal
videos.overview: Anne and the Plantars get transported to Earth, and try to adjust to a wild new environment.

videos.title: Hop 'Till You Drop
videos.overview: Anne brings the Plantars to the mall for a crash course in Earth survival.

videos.title: Turning Point
videos.overview: Sasha and Grime escape from Andrias and hide out in Wartwood.

videos.title: Thai Feud
videos.overview: Sprig tries to get rid of a food truck that's threatening the family business.

videos.title: Adventures in Catsitting
videos.overview: The Plantars volunteer to take Domino to the vet.

videos.title: Fight at the Museum
videos.overview: Anne and the Plantars try to rob a museum.

videos.title: Temple Frogs
videos.overview: The Boonchuys take the Plantars to the Thai Temple.

videos.title: Fixing Frobo
videos.overview: Polly tries to bring Frobo back to life.

videos.title: Anne-sterminator
videos.overview: A dangerous enemy finally locates Anne and the Plantars.

videos.title: Mr. X
videos.overview: Anne takes the Plantars to the movies, while the Boonchuys try to stop a government agent from finding them.

videos.title: Sprig’s Birthday
videos.overview: Anne tries to give Sprig a great Earth birthday.

videos.title: Spider-Sprig
videos.overview: Determined to make his mark on Earth, Sprig becomes a superhero.

videos.title: Olivia & Yunan
videos.overview: Back in Amphibia, Olivia and Yunan try to rescue Marcy.

videos.title: Hollywood Hop Pop
videos.overview: Hop Pop tries to make it as an actor in Hollywood.

videos.title: If You Give a Frog a Cookie
videos.overview: Anne trusts a questionable scientist who may have found a way to get them to Amphibia.

videos.title: Froggy Little Christmas
videos.overview: Anne attempts to surprise her mom with a Thai Go float for the city Christmas parade while the Plantars struggle to understand the holiday. Meanwhile, King Andrias prepares a deadly surprise.

videos.title: Escape to Amphibia
videos.overview: Anne and the gang have finally found a way home.  Unfortunately X has finally located them as well and is moving in.

videos.title: Commander Anne
videos.overview: Is Anne really commander material?  She seems to be kinda of bad at it.

videos.title: Sprivy
videos.overview: Sprig and Ivy are inseparable, much to the annoyance of everyone.

videos.title: Sasha's Angels
videos.overview: Sasha sends a team of her "elite" troops to take down some marauders.

videos.title: Olm Town Road
videos.overview: The gang look for the city of the Olms.

videos.title: Mother of Olms
videos.overview: Mother Olm's memory isn't what it used to be

videos.title: Grime's Pupil
videos.overview: Grime has to take on an apprentice, even if he is a boneless frog.

videos.title: The Root of Evil
videos.overview: A plant based hippie commune really puts the C in Cult.

videos.title: The Core & The King
videos.overview: Introducing Darcy the latest sensation sweeping Amphibia.  Also King Andrias revisits some old memories.

videos.title: Newts in Tights
videos.overview: Ann finds a merry band of tight wearing newts.

videos.title: Fight or Flight
videos.overview: Domino II is a mommy, and she's been captured!?

videos.title: The Three Armies
videos.overview: Time for some team building exercises.

videos.title: The Beginning of the End
videos.overview: The Battle for Amphibia begins.

videos.title: All In
videos.overview: Hello people of Earth.  Congratulations on being conquered.

videos.title: The Hardest Thing
videos.overview: Is saying goodbye.
